text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru is dejected after reading a critical magazine article about her run in the Kinko Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Coming to regret her heavy reliance on luck, she hopes to make amends with her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to enter the Takarazuka Kinen next, a race where the entrants are invited to participate based on fan votes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing no one wants her to compete, Matikanefukukitaru wallows in sadness.
